one_authentic_environment_contract.same_external_source: Two independent resets of the exact same original Farama MiniGrid family and seed; one separate env instance per native model because their chosen actions may diverge
one_authentic_environment_contract.real_env_interaction: FullyObsWrapper.reset(seed), original env.step(chosen 0/1/2), next public image and actual reward
one_authentic_environment_contract.public_observation: Only from original FullyObsWrapper observation['image']; public origin state may be parsed by the original K4R extractor; NO env.unwrapped, hidden grid, RNG, oracle actions, evaluator world labels, task seed or family supplied to native model
one_authentic_environment_contract.critical_wire_guard: Wingless original Go JSON uses EXACT snake_case field tags, not K4U CamelCase X/GoalX/FrontBlocked. All six fields must be explicitly present, finite and bounds-checked before the Go/colony adapter. A roundtrip test forbids silent default-goal/blocked fields.
one_authentic_environment_contract.native_episode: own native choose(public six field) -> original env.step(action) -> own native Observe(before, action, after, original reward, terminated OR truncated). Preserve terminated and truncated separately in evaluator trace.
one_authentic_environment_contract.no_shared_answer_or_weights: Native actors never receive each other's decisions, state, predicted values, observations from their diverged paths, or evaluator goal path. Initial same-seed public image SHA should match, but the full traces need NOT match after independent decisions.
one_authentic_environment_contract.no_planner_ownership_transfer: Planner/BFS and true full public wall image remain external evaluator/controls; original native sixfield projection must not be misrepresented as equally informed as a full-grid BFS planner.

source_training.FIT: Reuse original K4U 48 genuine independent source FIT episodes (24 family each), exactly one selected-public 0/1/2 action trace replayed in the same order into both unchanged native learners. No model sharing and no invented replay.
source_training.source_data: Original K4U K4R FullObsWrapper public six-field selected feedback only; convert original dict keys strictly to snake_case instead of silently unmapped Go fields
source_training.freeze_before_live_worlds: Both fully independent native FIT snapshots authenticated and cold restored before MG01 live paired worlds

live_development.source_feedback_budget: same exact initial public source training experiences; live turn counts may diverge with native decisions
